name: Juno International Corporation Class A (JUN.A)
summary: Juno International Corporation is a principal investment firm that takes controlling stakes in companies, favouring sectors such as technology, mining, oil and gas, aviation, premium alcoholic beverages, manufacturing and glass. It was incorporated in 1981 as Puissance Resources Limited, became Puissance Corporation in 1983, and took its current name in 1987. It is based in Toronto, Canada.
